text_block_list.text:
One day at the shopping mall, I spotted 
Admire Vega talking to a crying little 
child.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, what's wro—

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'd like to ask that myself.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Waaaah! It's too scaryyy~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
She's been like that the whole time. 
...Whenever I try to talk to her, she just 
cries.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? Look, no matter what I do—
choice_data_list:
I'll keep an eye on things, so go call a 
staff member.

I'll keep an eye on things, so go call a 
staff member.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, I get it.

Afterward, I had an announcement made over 
the PA system...

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Big sissss! That was so scaaary~~!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Geez! You can't just run off on your own! 
Come on, hold your big sister's hand!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

Seeing that the child was in a panic from 
being lost, I gently patted their back and 
waited for them to calm down――

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
...*sniff*. Big sis... went away 
somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ! ……I see.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Don't worry, I'm sure your big sister 
is looking for you too. Now, do you 
remember where you two got separated?

Afterward, I successfully managed to get 
the information...

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Horsey big sis! Trainer! Thank you! 
Bye-byee!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.
